how_to_tell_apart: Croatian is closest to Latin-script Serbian. The safer cues are ijekavian forms such as liječnik, lijepo, mlijeko and gdje, plus što as the default interrogative (Serbian subtitles often prefer šta and ekavian lekar, gde, hteo). Against Slovenian, ć and đ plus što/ovdje/sutra/hoću are enough; Slovenian would have kaj, tukaj and jutri instead. da, je, ne, se and hvala are shared and should not be used as evidence.
